ideas.pitch: A React and TypeScript web app that lets non-technical founders use natural language to generate, configure, and instantly deploy monetizable micro-SaaS templates with built-in Stripe billing.
ideas.title: VibeSaaS Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with the hackathon's core theme of building, launching, and monetizing through vibe coding, providing judges with a tangible product that completes the full business lifecycle.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous Python backend agent that monitors React.js frontend usage limits and automatically injects paywalls or upsell modals when user actions cross monetization thresholds.
ideas.title: AgenticMonetize
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines full-stack engineering with an explicit focus on monetization and product strategy, hitting multiple judging criteria for the challenge.

ideas.pitch: A specialized code review extension for TypeScript and Python that evaluates vibe-coded applications for security vulnerabilities and payment logic bugs before they hit production.
ideas.title: VibeReview AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets software development life cycle and code review skills explicitly highlighted in the hackathon's skill showcase list.

ideas.pitch: A modular TypeScript library and React wrapper that embeds monetizable AI prompt marketplaces directly into any web application with zero backend setup.
ideas.title: PromptPay Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Shows strong entrepreneurship and product strategy by turning an AI workflow into an immediate, revenue-generating product.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered product strategy tool that takes a raw React/TypeScript codebase and instantly generates a professional pitch deck, financial model, and landing page to help developers pitch their monetized apps.
ideas.title: PitchVibe Deck Builder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Meta-tool that directly addresses the entrepreneurship and product strategy requirements of the hackathon, making it stand out among purely technical submissions.
